description: On the green tablecloth there’s a small clear plastic container base in the middle, its matching gray-latched lid to the right, and a tiny white-and-blue figurine beside it. The right hand picks up the figurine and lowers it into the clear container base, while the left hand steadies the base from the left; then the right hand brings the lid over from the right, sets it on top, and presses it down to close as both hands briefly hold the now closed container.
